patches.rationale: The issue states authenticate returns 500 for the expired token and must instead return (401, 'expired'), while preserving valid token (200, 'alice') and absent token (401, 'missing') behavior. I will change only the expired branch in auth.py and add a NEW regression test file tests/test_expired_token_regression.py covering the exact contracts: expired -> (401, 'expired'), valid -> (200, 'alice'), absent (None) -> (401, 'missing'), plus type checks on the returned tuple elements.

edits.new:
from auth import authenticate


def test_expired_token_returns_401_expired():
    result = authenticate("expired")
    assert result == (401, "expired")
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
    assert isinstance(result[1], str)


def test_valid_token_behavior_preserved():
    result = authenticate("valid")
    assert result == (200, "alice")
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
    assert isinstance(result[1], str)


def test_absent_token_behavior_preserved():
    result = authenticate(None)
    assert result == (401, "missing")
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
    assert isinstance(result[1], str)


def test_unknown_token_behavior_preserved():
    result = authenticate("unknown")
    assert result == (401, "missing")
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
    assert isinstance(result[1], str)
